column1: # Sprite lists for atlases that come without one (atlas, sprite name, x,y,w,h), in the same form as
# the game's .txt lists; tools/uitext/build.py reads both.
# [font_wind: the yards, wind and slope numbers drawn in the 3D view (16x16 cells).
# tutorial_next: the "Next" prompt of the tutorial dialogs (64x32: a circle above, the button and Next below).
# [ground: the ground under the ball once it stops (words with their outlines and shadow).
# [font_ob_giveup / [font_waterhazard: the letters of OB, GIVE UP and WATER HAZARD shown in the 3D view.
# score_01 / score_02: the scoreboard's digit sets (no sprite list of their own): big white, grey,
# dark and bold white digits; small and middle digits. Lone dots and commas stay bitmaps.
